flags.title: Hires you without a real interview
flags.why: Legitimate employers interview candidates before making an offer.
flags.evidence: We have an urgent opening for a remote coordinator and you can start immediately.

flags.title: "HR" address on a free email service
flags.why: Company HR and recruiting teams normally write from the company's own domain, not gmail.com.

flags.title: Pressure to respond fast
flags.why: Urgency is used to stop you from checking the offer before you act.
flags.evidence: Please respond within 12 hours if interested.

flags.title: Several warning signs together
flags.why: One sign alone can be innocent. Several different ones in the same message is a strong scam pattern.
flags.evidence: 3 different warning signs in this message
